content:
Here are a few simple ways to acknowledge an email:

**Polite and professional:**
> Hi [Name],  
> Thank you for your email. I acknowledge receipt and will review it shortly.  
> Best regards,  
> [Your Name]

**If you received a document or information:**
> Hi [Name],  
> Thank you for sending this through. I confirm that I have received it.  
> Best regards,  
> [Your Name]

**If you will respond later:**
> Hi [Name],  
> Thank you for your email. I have received it and will get back to you soon with a response.  
> Best regards,  
> [Your Name]

**Short version:**
> Hi [Name],  
> Received, thank you.  
> Best,  
> [Your Name]
